name: onyvore
description: Local-first personal knowledge management for VS Code

onyvore.relatedNotes.enabled.markdownDescription: Compute **Related Notes** by document similarity. Turn this off to rely on `[[wikilinks]]` and title mentions alone.

onyvore.relatedNotes.threshold.markdownDescription: Minimum similarity (0–1) for two notes to count as related. Higher values mean fewer, closer matches.

onyvore.relatedNotes.maxPerNote.markdownDescription: How many related notes to keep per note. Bounds both the panel and the size of `links.json`.

onyvore.fileWatcher.debounceMs.markdownDescription: How long to wait for file changes to settle before reindexing. Raise it if an external tool writes many notes at once.

onyvore.wikilinks.showUnresolved.markdownDescription: Report `[[wikilinks]]` that point at no existing note as warnings in the Problems panel.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No notebooks found in this workspace.

A notebook is any folder containing an `.onyvore` directory. Your notes stay as ordinary markdown files — Onyvore only adds an index alongside them.

[Initialize Notebook](command:onyvore.initializeNotebook)
